title: The Renminbi After Bessent’s Interventions
text:
The Renminbi After Bessent’s Interventions

Wei He

Gavekal Dragonomics | 26 Aug 2026

The US dollar index is down about 2.4% since late July, following US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s twin interventions in financial markets: to push down the US dollar against the Japanese yen, and cap long-term US bond yields. That dollar weakness has, unsurprisingly, led to gains for the renminbi, which is up 0.7% against the dollar over the same period.But the response of the People’s Bank of China to these unusual interventions from the US has been telling. Rather than seizing the opportunity to push the currency higher, the PBOC has resisted market pressure for appreciation, and even achieved some depreciation in trade-weighted terms. That reaction confirms the PBOC’s turn to a more cautious stance on the currency in 2026 (see Dialing Back Expectations For Appreciation), and suggests the renminbi will probably not move a lot more in coming months.
